answer: To blunt Sybil swarms, a new account must lock a refundable stake and stay active across several windows; withdrawals follow only after a receding tide of quiet periods, so recycled capital cannot instantly fund the next fake. Reviewers sit in a shared meadow of attestations and down-weight clumps that share keys, funding trails, or identical timing. Each window paints a saffron dye—an epoch nonce that must be signed—so reused transcripts fail. An attacker who wants many voices therefore posts a stake per identity and waits out every unlock, tying up funds and time in proportion to the herd.
